    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Every job is a real button, labelled with its name, kind, how long it waited or ran, its place in line, priority and attempt
      - listitem: Roving focus – only one job is in the tab order, so the flow is a single stop
      - listitem: The pinned card is a dialog with a close button; Esc closes it and returns focus to the job
      - listitem: Rate limits, their end, failures, retries and crossing the backpressure line are announced in a polite live region
      - listitem: "The chart is an image with a text summary: how many wait now, the peak, the average and the rate-limited stretches"
      - listitem: Pause is a toggle button with aria-pressed; the stepper's buttons say what they do and the count is announced
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: New jobs drop in at the back of the queue; a high-priority job lands at the back first, then glides past the others
      - listitem: The front job moves into a free worker and becomes a bar that grows with its progress, with a sheen and a glowing front edge
      - listitem: A finished job turns green for a beat and flies into Done; a failed one shakes red and goes to Failed – or slides back into the queue with a retry badge
      - listitem: During a rate limit the bars stop and turn amber, a countdown runs out; the chart line climbs, then falls as the queue drains
      - listitem: The numbers ease to their new value and the chart's scale glides when it changes – one frame loop that sleeps when nothing moves or the queue is off-screen
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything appears in place
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: "Built on a container query and the measured width: wide, the flow runs left to right – queue, workers, Done and Failed"
      - listitem: "Under 600px the flow stacks: queue on top, the workers below (just their marks, the rail gets the room), Done and Failed side by side"
      - listitem: The four numbers wrap to two columns; under 440px Pause and the stepper get a row of their own
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Pass the whole list every time something changes – ids keep jobs in place and every change glides
      - listitem: All times are on one clock – epoch ms, or your own (then pass now)
      - listitem: A retry is the same id going back to "queued" with attempt + 1, a new enqueuedAt and no startedAt or worker
      - listitem: "The chart is computed from the jobs: keep finished jobs for as long as window, or pass totals and accept a shorter history"
      - listitem: Pass progress while a job runs for honest bars; otherwise give an estimate
